# Apocalypse Hackathon

**Event Type:** "The high school hackathon where you build fun tech to survive the zombie apocalypse!"

**Location:** Shopify Toronto, 620 King St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1M6

**Dates:** May 17-19, 2024

This was a 44-hour coding marathon organized by Hack Club where approximately 150 teenage participants collaborated on technology projects with a zombie apocalypse theme.

content.content:
# Harvest Event Summary

**Event Name:** Harvest

**Type:** A social coding event for middle and high school students focused on building creative projects and learning to code.

**Location:** Karma Bird House in Burlington, Vermont

**Date:** Saturday, October 28, 2023

**Time:** 1pm-8pm

According to the webpage, "Harvest is a social coding event open to all middle and high school students" where participants come together to "discover the joy of code, build creative projects, and share them with the world." The event was organized by teenagers at Hack Club and was entirely free to attend.

Build passes — both new pages compile as static routes. Everything's in place (uncommitted, ready for you to review).

## What I added

**Concerts** (`src/lib/defs.ts`):
- **Lake Street Dive with Couch** — Shelburne Museum, Shelburne VT, 2026-08-11 (from your ticket)
- **It's A 2000s Party: Boston** — House of Blues, Boston MA, 2026-02-06 (dug the date out of the Ticketmaster email; you bought this Jan 23). It's an 18+ DJ party rather than a band, so pull it if it doesn't belong on this page.

**`/conferences`** (new page + `Conference` type):
- **Actuate 26** — Foxglove, Fort Mason Center, San Francisco, Aug 18–19, 2026 (from your Outlook order #79691301 — that's next week!)
- **See Change Sessions** — Burlington VT, Sep 17–19, 2024 (worked/crew)
- **See Change Sessions Pop-Up** — Hula, Burlington VT, Feb 2024 (exact date has a TODO; your Eventbrite order was Feb 14 but the email didn't state the event date)

**`/hackathons`** (new page + `Hackathon` type), newest first:
- **NewHacks** — University of Toronto, Oct 24–26, 2025, MLH Coach
- **HackHarvard** — Cambridge MA, Oct 3–5, 2025, MLH Coach
- **SteelHacks XII** — University of Pittsburgh, Sep 20–21, 2025, MLH Coach (verified the "XII" and the 2025-09-20 date from your MLH deployment emails)
- **Apocalypse** — Shopify Toronto, May 17–19, 2024, attendee & Hack Club staff
- **The Summit** — San Francisco, Feb 9–11, 2024, Logistics Lead (year confirmed via your Jan 2024 planning emails)
- **Harvest** — Karma Bird House, Burlington VT, Oct 28, 2023, marked as a favorite with "My first hackathon!"

Both pages follow the concerts page pattern exactly: year grouping, JSON-LD Event schema, MENU/FOOTER, Balgin font, dark mode. I also registered both in the `pages` array and on `/slashes`.

## Things for you to fill in or confirm

- **Couch at Roadrunner (Nov 22, 2025)** — you bought 3 tickets but resold all of them per AXS emails, so I did **not** add it. Say the word if you actually went.
- **See Change Sept 2025** — I found no evidence you attended/worked the 2025 flagship, so it's not listed.
- **NewHacks** — your flight was cancelled Sep 29 but later emails suggest you still coached it; included, but double-check.
- **HackWIT** — commented out in `defs.ts` with a TODO since I couldn't confirm it happened / its final date. Uncomment and fill in when ready.
- **GHW Open Source Week** (online, Oct 2025) and the **Logic Robotics hackathon at WIT** (Apr 2026) were unconfirmed, so I left them off.
